name: COB — DIS/DMM/897 dual membership with RB1 on the primary claim → Validate and Pay
description: Nine steps mapping one-to-one onto the RB1.1 source document: read the four informational events as one situation, confirm dual membership and the primary policy's dates, check the group is not a Non-Medical Plan, review the Limited Liability record, confirm the claim is keyed correctly, determine the Primary claim position, confirm PX_RB1 on the primary claim, validate, and pay.

steps.name: Identify the DIS/DMM/897/RB1 events and check the hierarchy
steps.description: Open the Event Resolution tab. It lists every edit on the claim: PX_DIS, PX_DMM, PX_897 and PX_RB1, all informational. They are one coordination-of-benefits situation, not four claims to work — PX_DIS and PX_DMM say the member has two policies with Anthem, PX_897 is a further informational event for that situation, and PX_RB1 is the event you are processing. Because the PX_DIS event is present, follow the Dual Membership review process. Then read the All Edits list to check whether any higher-priority event must be resolved first under the established hierarchy. No other event is present, so proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Event Resolution tab is opened while this step is active. The workspace opens with no tab selected, so the trainee opens it deliberately.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', All Edits lists PX_DIS, PX_DMM, PX_897 and PX_RB1 — all informational, with PX_RB1 active. Nothing else is listed, so no higher-priority event blocks the review.
steps.checklistItem: Identify the DIS/DMM/897/RB1 events and check the hierarchy

steps.name: Confirm dual membership and the primary policy dates
steps.description: Open the Search tab and its Member sub-tab. The search has already been run with the Member ID, First name and Last name, so the member is listed: Member ID 12345678, First name John, Last name K, DOB 1/1/2000. Review the enrolment and determine whether the member has coverage under the same Member ID with two different groups. Two contract lines are listed beneath the member — Primary Policy ID 12345678 and Secondary Policy ID 87654321 — so dual membership coverage exists. Then check that the claim's Receipt date falls inside the primary policy group's effective and end dates: the receipt date is 09/26/2026 and the primary policy runs 01/01/2025 to 12/31/2028, so it falls within range. Dual membership exists, so proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Member sub-tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Search → Member', the member row shows Member ID 12345678, John K, DOB 1/1/2000, with two contract lines beneath it: policy 12345678 and policy 87654321. Compare the claim's receipt date, 09/26/2026, with the primary policy's 01/01/2025 – 12/31/2028.
steps.checklistItem: Confirm dual membership and the primary policy dates

steps.name: Verify the group is not a Non-Medical Plan
steps.description: Still on the Search → Member sub-tab, scroll down to the Member / Group Information area and open the Group Contract Information section to review the Product/Group details. Determine whether the claim is associated with a Non-Medical Plan: if it is, the non-medical (Dental, Vision) processing guidelines apply instead. The Product line field reads PPO PB INCENTIVE, so the group is not a Non-Medical Plan and you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Group Contract Information section is opened. The section stays shut — and its Product line unreadable — until this step is active.
steps.hint: Scroll to the Group Information panel below the member results and click the 'Group Contract Information' section header to open it. Product line reads PPO PB INCENTIVE — a medical plan, so the non-medical guidelines do not apply.
steps.checklistItem: Verify the group is not a Non-Medical Plan

steps.name: Review the Limited Liability records
steps.description: Open the Search tab's Limited Liability sub-tab and review the Limited Liability (LL) records. One record is on file: Type cob, Effective date 1/1/2024, no End date. Both memberships are active and the LL record is clear, so proceed to review the coordination order and confirm the claim is keyed correctly. Note the Member ID from the search input box — 12345678 — because the next step compares it against the claim.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Limited Liability sub-tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Search → Limited Liability', Limited Liability Results lists one record: Type cob, Effective date 1/1/2024, End date blank, Order of benefits 'P – Our Insurance is primary'. The Member ID in the search box above it is 12345678.

steps.name: Confirm the claim is keyed correctly
steps.description: Go back to the Search → Member sub-tab and open the primary policy's contract line — policy 12345678. Check that the Member ID carried from the Limited Liability search, 12345678, matches the HCID field on that line, which reads 12345678. The values match, so the claim is keyed correctly and you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the PRIMARY policy's contract line is opened. The secondary policy's line dispatches nothing and completes no step.
steps.hint: Back on 'Search → Member', expand the contract line for policy 12345678 — the primary one — and read its HCID. It reads 12345678, the same value as the Member ID.
steps.checklistItem: Confirm the claim is keyed correctly

steps.name: Determine the claim position (Primary)
steps.description: Return to the Search → Limited Liability sub-tab and click 'Open record' on the cob record to review the coordination order. The record shows Order of benefits 'P – Our Insurance is primary'. Determine whether the claim is being processed under the Primary Plan or the Secondary Plan. The claim is keyed as Primary — it matches the Primary Policy ID 12345678 — so follow the Primary processing guidelines.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the LL record is opened. The Order of benefits is also shown in the results row, so what this step grades is opening the record and reading the coordination order against the claim, not first sight of the value.
steps.hint: Click 'Open record' on the cob row. Order of benefits reads 'P – Our Insurance is primary', and the Primary Policy ID 12345678 is this claim's member — so the claim sits in the Primary position.

steps.name: Confirm the RB1 event on the primary claim
steps.description: Processing the claim as Primary, go back to the Event Resolution tab and check whether the RB1 event sets on the primary claim. PX_RB1 — Eligible Dup In Service Split — is present and is the active event, so proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Event Resolution tab is re-opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', the Active Edit section shows Edit Code PX_RB1 with the description ELIGIBLE DUP IN SERVICE SPLIT.
steps.checklistItem: Confirm the RB1 event on the primary claim

steps.name: Validate the claim
steps.description: Click the Validate button on the claim summary bar so the claim is processed according to normal benefits and contract guidelines. The Validation section on the Event Resolution tab confirms the claim has been validated.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Validate is pressed while this step is active. A press before that is refused outright — no writes, no validation message.
steps.hint: Click 'Validate' on the claim summary bar at the top of the workspace. The Validation section then reads that the claim was processed under normal benefits and contract guidelines.

steps.name: Submit Pay decision
steps.description: The claim is keyed as Primary, the group is a medical plan and the claim validated under normal benefits, so pay it. Go to the Decision section on the claim summary, select 'Pay' from the dropdown and click Submit. Once RB1 is processed, CI&W generates a claim with the secondary policy details carrying the RB2 event after 24 hours — that claim is adjudicated separately and is not part of this one.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Pay decision is submitted.
steps.hint: Select 'Pay' from the Decision dropdown on the claim summary, then click Submit.
